name: rainbow-html
description: Alternating rainbow colors for HTML tag delimiters and names to enhance complex nested HTML readability.

rainbow-html.additionalFileTypes.description: Additional file extensions (e.g., 'njk') or language IDs (e.g., 'nunjucks') to scan for HTML tags.

enumDescriptions: Calculate tag color by hashing the tag name into a pool of vivid colors.
Assign unique vivid colors to each distinct tag type in the document and immediate surroundings.
Alternating rainbow colors based on tag nesting depth (legacy mode).

rainbow-html.tagColors.description: Manual color overrides for specific tag names (e.g., {"div": "#ff5555", "span": "#50fa7b"}). Tag names are case-insensitive.

rainbow-html.tagShadow.description: Configurable CSS text-shadow applied to HTML tag names in the editor (e.g. '1px 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)', '0px 1px 3px #000000', or 'none' to disable).
